summary: Russell Jacobs, 25, of Westminster became lost on the Keyhole Route in rapidly deteriorating winter-like weather; late Friday afternoon he contacted a friend by cell phone and briefly texted park rangers that he would try to reach the Agnes Vaille Shelter, then communication was lost. RMNP SAR searched the Boulder Field/Keyhole area overnight in snow, ice and 35+ mph winds; park visitors found his body Saturday about 80 feet above the Ledges past the Keyhole; Trans Aero helicopter recovery Sunday.
location: Keyhole Route, Longs Peak (above the Ledges past the Keyhole), Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: National Park Service; Northern Colorado Med Evac (air search)
